name: @pqp-vendor/emulatorjs-core-bsnes
license: GPL-3.0-or-later AND ISC AND MIT AND LGPL-2.1-or-later
description: The bsnes libretro core built for EmulatorJS, from source, with two fixes (source/). EmulatorJS has not published bsnes to npm, and its own nightly build cannot save or load a state or reset. Same shape as an @emulatorjs/core-* package so apps/locadora/prepare.mts reads it the same way.

pqpProvenance.built: 2026-10-20T19:36:49Z to 2026-10-20T19:50:03Z, macOS arm64, emsdk 3.1.74, by source/build.sh

patches: source/libco-emscripten-fiber.patch: adds co_derive and co_serializable to bsnes-libretro's libco/emscripten_fiber.c (without them a state save, a state load and a reset abort the runtime)

source/retroarch-save-state-info.patch: RetroArch's save_state_info returned a local array by address (a null pointer at -O3, so every save failed), and it serialised from inside the JavaScript call, where bsnes's fibers cannot switch; now the main loop makes the state at the top of its next tick and save_state_info answers pending until it is there
